title: Buttery Gooey Low-Carb Kimbap Rice Paper Roll
description: This low-carb kimbap roll is buttery and gooey with a touch of indulgence, perfect for snacking or as an afternoon treat.
instructions: Knead together the ground chicken and optional low-carb mayo until well combined.
Dip one rice paper sheet into water to make it more pliable, then lay flat on a clean surface.
Place a small amount of the chicken mixture in the center of the rice paper sheet, leaving about 1 inch around the edges.
Fold sides over to enclose the filling, and roll tightly like making sushi. Repeat with remaining sheets.
Optional: Add soft cheese puffs inside each rolled kimbap for extra indulgence.
Serve immediately or store in an airtight container until ready to eat.
